ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-cream florets, matte surface with slight golden-yellow tinge on some tips, firm and holding shape, bite-sized clusters 2-4 cm across with branching stems, some lightly browned or dry-edged spots, scattered across the right and upper portion of the plate covering roughly 45% of the plate | 310

ITEM 2 | Dark brown meat piece with a rough, seared-looking exterior and dry crusty edges, topped with a dense layer of finely chopped green herb-and-seed mixture with flecks of bright green and small sprigs, slightly moist look, irregular mound about 6 x 4 cm and 2 cm thick, sitting at the lower left edge of the cauliflower | 85
